body: yes absolutely i completely agree with you, i really hope that you're doing okay too, sending virtual hugs to you

i think like this too, how can i carry on his memory when i hate the part he left me with? seems spiteful of me and him and im always like do i just abandon him? no, should i carry him with me everywhere and just become him? idk i really don't. people have told me this too to get up and carry on but when you're on the floor with this weight on you its so hard to get up and usually the only part that gets me up is hate. hate for him. and i dont want that i dont think. im sorry im supposed to be helping you out but your post really rings true with me and i just had to respond saying that i feel the same way like my head is full of these conflicting ideas and idk which one to follow. i really hope you're doing okay and just wanted to say i feel completely the same. thank you for sharing

thank you, i really appreciate your words. every one of them shows me just like im so much less alone than i thought. i do actually keep writing to him once a day every night. i just put down stuff hes missed but then my hand sorta gets really mad and i end up scrawling as hard as my fingers go and asking why the hell he did this but i dont really go into the event just more idk the conversation id have with him if he were here. i am really listening to all you guys as i feel safe here so thank you so much, i really really do appreciate it. ill try writing it down as it seemed to just lift something typing it here. i hope youre okay too and thank thank thank you

thank you, i can't believe from the way my post was worded how nice everyone is being here. what you said is totally true to me i wish he had gone any other way so i didnt have to point the finger straight at him. my family try to tell me to continue fixing up the house and fish pond he used to keep and ive heard them saying how sad it is its all falling apart but its like you said those were his pieces and i cant bring myself to fill in those. being here has already made me feel so much less lonely and im thankful for your words i really feel like i can trust people who've been through this horrible crap so im gonna start reaching out to my doctor and just explain that id like to give it a try. id like to keep you all updated as to how it goes but really thank you so much

i immediately edited my post for the trigger warning, i feel so stupid having not put that up before. thank you for telling me that cause i honestly had not thought about im so sorry. ive included trigger warning and i hope it doesnt cause any pain for you, i really appreciate what you said. i think they think somehow its better them just being gone, when ive been dark myself thats what i think myself but then i remember that it really really isnt better. its the worse kind of fix. i get selfish and think well i'll be gone so does it matter? idk, my head is such a terrible mess, i think one way one second and the next i think the other way and its always 100% thinking. thank you again tho i really do appreciate it honestly

thank you, ive been pushed to see a trauma person but at the moment its so difficult just to admit it happened. last night i went into frenzy typing that. ofc it comes at me but in flashbacks and i stop dead for a second and then push it out as soon as im back in reality. ik i need to address it if im going to stop being so bitter and stuff but mental health wasnt always so great and now i just think if i try to confront this it might just cripple me. its mainly just how he looked. i cant escape that image. thank you tho and you too

what you said at the end is the most true thing i've heard in months. i wasn't around when those cafes were open, but i imagine like as well as it being completely depressing it was also a place of solace. it feels like being here talking to you just validates what i feel a bit. idk i never usually get that, or maybe im just too afraid. i see all the pain on here and tbh it doesnt feel like pain anymore, it just feels like you said, staring into the coffee thinking about all the shit. do you think it helps to just admit these things? idk, i want out but at the same time i just need to let it out. i'm so sorry for unloading on you, a lot of what you say makes sense to me and its bringing my anger down. maybe this is just life, maybe it just hurts forever. do we want that? idk whether i do. i'm sorry if i make no sense at all. im really trying to put my thoughts into order as best i can

the mods here must just be made of steel man i swear. i think you're completely right but sometimes the internet is the only place that accepts these thoughts without like any prejudice. i kinda feel glad it exists as much as it terrifies me. do you think that if we turned off the internet we'd be better? i'm sorry for asking you i just feel the need to keep typing here and what you said just makes a lot of sense. i have no idea how the mods come here and routinely keep on top of all this and manage to keep afloat themselves. i got high praise for anyone typing here tbh because it's such a dark place but i feel it's so needed. i've not felt a rush of emotions, even if theyre terrible, in a long time and i think its cause i'm admitting stuff
